entries.title: See Usage by project, and for each recent task
entries.body: In Settings, Usage, Where it went now lists Firstmate first, then each project with its subtotal and its kinds of work beneath it, such as Implementation and Fixes, then other work. A new Recent tasks list shows each task's input, output, cache read, cache write and total, newest first, ten at a time with See more. The rows no longer have lines between them.

picture.alt: Settings, Usage: the Recent tasks list, each task beside its input, output, cache read, cache write and total
